title: Export honey to the EU
summary: Natural honey (HS 0409) destined for the European Union

steps.title: Confirm product classification
steps.detail: Natural honey falls under HS code 0409. This decides which standards and market rules apply.

steps.title: Meet the applicable standard
steps.detail: Comply with SZNS 060 (composition, moisture, HMF) aligned to CODEX STAN 12.

action.label: Buy SZNS 060:2019
action.reason: Buying a standard requires an account so we can license the download to you.

steps.title: Get product testing & certification
steps.detail: Submit a sample for lab testing (moisture, sugars, contaminants), then apply for product certification.

action.label: Apply for certification
action.reason: Applying creates a tracked case under your account.

steps.title: Meet EU market requirements
steps.detail: EU Honey Directive 2001/110/EC applies. Honey also needs an approved national residue-monitoring plan.

steps.title: Prepare export documentation
steps.detail: Assemble the health certificate, traceability records and test reports. Our export desk can review your pack.

action.label: Request export review
action.reason: An export review is tracked under your account.
